_comment: CISCE's OFFICIAL marking scheme for ISC 2025 Mathematics Q1, transcribed
from the Analysis of Pupil Performance (Oct 2025) p11 MARKING SCHEME block.
⚠ WITHHOLD THIS FILE FROM ANY BLIND DERIVER. It exists to be diffed against
independently derived answers AFTER they are produced, never to be handed
out alongside the questions. The dump step must emit .questions.json only.
⚠ SUBPART (v) HAS TWO ACCEPTED ANSWERS. CISCE prints '(c) … / (a) …' —
the paper accepted both, which is the `grace` case the mock engine already
models (full marks to all, no penalty). It is recorded as a LIST here rather
than flattened to a single letter: flattening would manufacture a
disagreement against whichever branch a deriver reached, and would ship a
question that marks a correct student wrong.
The MCQ entries carry BOTH the letter and CISCE's restatement of the value
('(b) or Null matrix'), so a letter/value mismatch in our own transcription
subject: Mathematics
source: Analysis of Pupil Performance, Oct 2025, p11

answers.value: Assertion is true and Reason is false. / Both Assertion and Reason are true and Reason is the correct explanation for Assertion.
answers.graceNote: CISCE printed both (c) and (a) as acceptable. Treat as awarded-to-all rather than picking one.
